script_text: Fire ignites Aries, shaking every chart corner of your week! Monday’s Sun trine Mars in your 1st House fuels bold confidence for new projects and energizes initiatives across all pursuits. Tuesday's Venus opposes Pluto in your 7th House, stirring intense romance and testing trust with partners and deep emotional turbulence. Wednesday Mercury sextiles Jupiter in your 2nd House, opening sudden and unexpected financial gains. Thursday the Sun enters your 5th House, amplifying love as Venus trines Neptune, sparking dreamy romance and creative spark. Friday the Moon conjoins Mars, supercharging your Fire spirit and urging bold personal moves in both love and work. Sunday powers you as Mars fuels your 6th House, boosting productivity, health, and crystal‑clear focus. Wednesday feels as Mercury squares Saturn, stalling career momentum and delaying progress. Stay hydrated, move daily to keep your Fire spirit strong this week. Follow for daily updates.
